title: Crispy Malaysian Pork Ribs
description: A fusion of Malaysian and savory flavors, these crispy pork ribs are perfect for a dinner party.

ingredients.name: Pork back ribs
ingredients.notes: Remove the membrane from the back of the ribs

ingredients.name: Light soy sauce
ingredients.notes: Use a mild, light soy sauce

ingredients.name: Savory stir fry sauce
ingredients.notes: Find this at an Asian market or online

ingredients.name: Crunchy rice flour
ingredients.notes: A type of rice flour that produces a crispy coating

ingredients.name: Malaysian chili flakes
ingredients.notes: Adjust to taste for heat level

ingredients.name: Brown sugar
ingredients.notes: Helps balance the heat from the chili flakes

instructions: In a small bowl, mix together the light soy sauce, savory stir fry sauce, Malaysian chili flakes, and brown sugar.
Place the pork ribs on a baking sheet lined with parchment paper.
Brush the soy sauce mixture onto the ribs, making sure they're evenly coated.
Sprinkle the crunchy rice flour over the ribs, pressing it onto the meat to help it adhere.
Drizzle the vegetable oil over the ribs.
Bake the ribs in the preheated oven for 20 minutes.
Increase the oven temperature to broil and cook for an additional 5-7 minutes, or until the rice flour is crispy and golden brown.
Remove the ribs from the oven and let them rest for 5 minutes before serving.
